mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), easing supply chain constraints reduce input costs and boost corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing expansion regimes (INDPRO growth > 1.0% annually), supply chain improvements boost corporate production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% annually, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
